ops.label: ALB

ops.label: WAF

ops.label: Web servers

ops.label: Orders DB

ops.label: Product images

ops.label: Logs
ops.why: Centralizes application logs for troubleshooting and alerts.

ops.label: CloudMonitor
ops.why: Monitors resource metrics and triggers alarms during peaks.

turns.summary: Backend for an Indonesian ride-hailing platform designed in Jakarta (jkt) to keep customer data local. To meet the no-Kubernetes constraint, eight microservices (auth, rider, driver, dispatch, trip, fare, payment, notify) run on SAE across two zones. The architecture includes a Cloud-native API Gateway, RDS for relational data, and Tair for caching. RocketMQ handles async messaging, while ESA and DNS manage edge routing from mobile apps. Logs are stored in SLS. All components are deployed within a VPC with multi-zone redundancy.

turns.summary: Backend for an Indonesian ride-hailing platform designed in Jakarta to keep customer data local. To meet the no-Kubernetes constraint, eight microservices (auth, rider, driver, dispatch, trip, fare, payment, notify) run on SAE across two zones. The architecture includes a Cloud-native API Gateway, RDS for relational data, and Tair for caching. RocketMQ handles async messaging, including trip events via e-trip-mq, so no additional message queue was added. ESA and DNS manage edge routing from mobile apps. Logs are stored in SLS. All components are deployed within a VPC with multi-zone redundancy.
